purpose: City parcel geometry and registry/cadastre research; local registry evidence and publicly retrievable vector geometry are assessed independently.
name: Jhelum

queries.query: Jhelum Pakistan official cadastral map land records parcel GIS Punjab
queries.result: Found official Punjab/PLRA land-record and PULSE sources, plus the Municipal Committee Jhelum services-map page. MC Jhelum links a 2023-24 base-map PDF whose legend includes parcel boundaries. PULSE also exposes a public viewer describing Jhelum cadastral maps, but its ArcGIS service is token-gated for REST access.

queries.query: جہلم پاکستان سرکاری کادستر نقشہ اراضی ریکارڈ GIS پارسل
queries.result: Search results identified the official Punjab Land Records cadastral-map interface and Punjab PULSE/PLRA land-record services. The public interfaces require district/tehsil/village selection or viewer-side access; no anonymous safe Jhelum polygon response was exposed in the bounded review.

officialSources.observation: Official Municipal Committee Jhelum services-map page lists the Base Map Jhelum City under the 2023-24 map set.

Official MC Jhelum PDF, prepared by the municipal GIS Officer, has a legend for Parcel Boundary and shows parcel boundaries in the city base map. It is a rendered map document, not an exposed vector parcel API.
Punjab Urban Land Systems Enhancement public viewer lists Cadastral Maps including Jhelum and a Parcels layer; the viewer states its lines are indicative and not legal boundaries.

Official District Administration page assigns Revenue Administration maintenance of land records and supervision of LRMIS centers; this establishes district revenue custody context, not vector geometry.
Official Punjab Land Records cadastral-map interface exposes village-wise district, tehsil, and village selection, but the bounded anonymous review did not retrieve a Jhelum geometry response.

registryBasis: Official Municipal Committee Jhelum material provides a city base map with an explicit parcel-boundary layer/legend, while the official Punjab district administration identifies revenue/LRMIS custody. The evidence establishes local/public cadastral-map context but not legal title coverage or a public vector endpoint.

safeFieldAllowlist: parcel/cadastral identifier only if exposed by a future anonymous safe endpoint
remainingUncertainty: The MC Jhelum PDF is a rendered map and does not prove complete or current parcel coverage. PULSE advertises Jhelum cadastral layers, but anonymous ArcGIS REST inspection was token-gated; no polygon IDs, schema, CRS, or citywide completeness were verified. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, or account fields were requested or retained.
